messages.content: What is the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin?

message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is usually **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time).  
During daylight‑saving periods the offset can shift:

| Period | Los Angeles | Berlin | Difference |
|--------|-------------|--------|------------|
| Standard time (winter) | PST (UTC‑8) | CET (UTC+1) | +9 h |
| Daylight saving (summer) | PDT (UTC‑7) | CEST (UTC+2) | +9 h |

So when it’s noon in Los Angeles, it’s 9 p.m. in Berlin (or 10 p.m. if both cities are observing daylight saving at the same time).

Los Angeles is PST/PDT; Berlin is CET/CEST. So difference can be 9 or 10 hours depending on DST. Provide explanation. No function needed.
